location.en: Maple Bay Language Institute, school library
location.zh: 楓灣語言學院，學校圖書館

goal.en: Get a library card and borrow your first book.
goal.zh: 辦好借書證，借出第一本書。

background: quiet school library with tall wooden bookshelves, a front desk with a computer and a returned books cart, reading tables with green lamps, soft afternoon light

intro.en: Ms. Reed recommended an easy English novel. You found it on the shelf!
intro.zh: 瑞德老師推薦了一本簡單的英文小說，你在書架上找到了！

intro.en: Good afternoon. How can I help you?

lines.en: Ah, that's a nice book. What can I do for you?
lines.zh: 啊，那本書不錯。有什麼我能幫你的？

choices.en: Hi. I'd like to borrow this book, please.
choices.zh: 你好，我想借這本書，麻煩了。
choices.tip: borrow 是「借入」，從別人那裡拿來用。I'd like to... 是禮貌提出需求的好用句型。

choices.en: Hi. I would like to lend this book.

lines.en: Lend it to us? How generous! A donation, then?
lines.zh: 借給我們？真慷慨！所以是要捐書嗎？

story.en: Mr. Bell thanks you warmly and puts the book on the donation shelf. You walk out with a thank-you card instead of a book.
story.zh: 貝爾先生熱情道謝，把書放上捐贈書架。你沒借到書，只拿到一張感謝卡。

fail.why: 中文的「借」不分方向，英文要分清楚：borrow 是借入，lend 是借出。想把書帶回家要說 I'd like to borrow this book.。

choices.en: This one. I'll take it home, OK?

lines.en: Not so fast! This is a library, not a free shop.
lines.zh: 別急！這裡是圖書館，不是免費商店。

story.en: Mr. Bell holds the book tightly until you calm down. The students at the reading tables look up from their books.
story.zh: 貝爾先生緊緊抱著書，直到你冷靜下來。閱讀桌的同學們都抬頭看你。

fail.why: I'll take it home, OK? 聽起來像在宣布而不是請求，很沒禮貌。借書要說 I'd like to borrow this book.。

lines.en: Sure. Do you have a library card?

choices.en: Not yet. How do I get one?
choices.tip: Not yet. 表示「還沒有，但打算要」。How do I get one? 的 one 代替前面說過的 library card。

choices.en: No. I don't have. How can I get?
choices.zh: 沒有，我沒有。要怎麼拿到？

lines.en: You don't have... what? Get... what?
lines.zh: 你沒有……什麼？要拿到……什麼？

story.en: Mr. Bell guesses "a pen," then "a bag," then "a friend." The library card is his tenth guess.
story.zh: 貝爾先生猜了「筆」、「包包」、「朋友」……猜到第十次才猜中借書證。

fail.why: have 和 get 後面要接受詞，不能空著。用 one 代替前面提過的東西：I don't have one. How can I get one?。

choices.en: No, I only have cash. Is that OK?
choices.zh: 沒有，我只有現金。這樣可以嗎？

lines.en: Cash? Borrowing books is free. You don't need to pay.
lines.zh: 現金？借書是免費的，不用付錢。

story.en: You thought a card meant a credit card. Mr. Bell kindly explains, and you put your wallet away with red cheeks.
story.zh: 你以為 card 是信用卡。貝爾先生親切地解釋，你紅著臉把錢包收起來。

fail.why: library card 是借書證，不是信用卡。聽到不熟的詞，可以先說 Not yet. 再問 How do I get one?。

lines.en: Just show me your student ID. ... There you go! Your card is ready.
lines.zh: 給我看你的學生證就好。……好了！你的借書證辦好了。

choices.tip: due 是「到期」，When is it due? 是問還書日期、繳交期限的標準說法。

choices.en: Thank you. When I should give back?
choices.zh: 謝謝。我應該什麼時候還？

lines.en: Give back... the card? You just got it!
lines.zh: 還……借書證？你才剛拿到耶！

story.en: Mr. Bell holds out his hand for the new card. You hold it tightly and slowly back away.
story.zh: 貝爾先生伸手要收回剛辦好的借書證。你緊緊握著卡，慢慢往後退。

fail.why: 問句要倒裝：When should I...?，而且 give back 後面要說清楚還什麼。最簡單的說法是 When is it due?。

lines.en: Whenever? Libraries don't work like that, I'm afraid.
lines.zh: 有空再還？圖書館恐怕不是這樣運作的。

story.en: Mr. Bell writes your name on a small yellow note and sticks it on his screen. You feel watched every time you walk by.
story.zh: 貝爾先生把你的名字寫在黃色便利貼上，貼在螢幕旁。之後你每次經過都覺得被盯著。

fail.why: whenever 聽起來很隨便，好像不打算準時還書。借東西時要主動問期限：When is it due?。

lines.en: It's due in two weeks, on the 20th.
lines.zh: 兩週後到期，20 號要還。

choices.en: Can I renew it if I need more time?
choices.zh: 如果需要更多時間，可以續借嗎？
choices.tip: renew 是「續借」，也可以用在續約、更新證件。Can I renew it? 是圖書館必學句。

choices.en: If not finish, can I borrow again more?
choices.zh: 如果沒看完，可以再借多一點嗎？

lines.en: More books? Sure, you can borrow up to five!
lines.zh: 更多書？可以啊，最多能借五本！

story.en: You leave with five thick novels in your arms. You can't even finish the first one in two weeks.
story.zh: 你抱著五本厚厚的小說離開。兩週內，你連第一本都看不完。

fail.why: 「再借」直譯成 borrow again more，聽起來像要多借幾本。延長借期要用 renew：Can I renew it if I need more time?。

choices.en: Two weeks? That's too short for me.

lines.en: Hmm. It's the same for every student here.
lines.zh: 嗯。這裡每個學生都一樣喔。

story.en: Mr. Bell gives you a long speech about library rules. By the end, you only have thirteen days left.
story.zh: 貝爾先生跟你講了一大段圖書館規則。講完時，你只剩十三天了。

fail.why: 直接抱怨規則不合理，聽起來像在找麻煩。想要更多時間，就問有沒有辦法：Can I renew it if I need more time?。

lines.en: Of course. You can renew it online or right here. Enjoy the book!
lines.zh: 當然可以。線上或在這裡都能續借。好好享受這本書！

story.en: You walk out with your first library card and your first English novel. Mr. Bell even adds a bookmark.
story.zh: 你帶著人生第一張借書證和第一本英文小說走出圖書館。貝爾先生還送了你一張書籤。

notes.en: I'd like to borrow this book.
notes.explain: I'd like to... 是 I want to... 的禮貌版，在櫃台、餐廳、辦公室都好用。

example.en: I'd like to borrow these two DVDs.

notes.explain: due 表示「到期、截止」。還書日叫 due date，交作業期限也可以用：When is the essay due?。
renew 是延長期限，可以用在書、會員、簽證、合約。renew a book 就是續借。

example.en: I need to renew my visa next month.
example.zh: 我下個月要辦簽證展延。

notes.explain: have、get、need 後面一定要有受詞。用 one 代替前面提過的可數名詞，不要說 I don't have.。

example.en: A: Do you have a pen? B: Sorry, I don't have one.

notes.explain: 中文都說「借」，英文要分方向：borrow 是從別人那裡借來，lend 是借給別人。I lend this book 會被聽成你要把書借出去。

example.en: Can I borrow your notes? / Can you lend me your notes?
example.zh: 我可以借你的筆記嗎？／你可以借我筆記嗎？
